description: A gradient whose first stop is a hard edge pads with the first stop's color, not the color after the edge: a thin red line on a clear ground, as a margin on ruled paper.

florui.css: .box { width: 120px; height: 80px; background-color: #f4ecd9; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 40px, rgba(196, 71, 47, 0.5) 40px 41px, transparent 41px), repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0 19px, rgba(74, 112, 160, 0.4) 19px 20px); }

classification.reason: Chromium dithers gradients, so a smooth gradient differs from this engine by one level of 255 on a third of its pixels (max error 1, mean about 0.3); channel_tolerance 2 stops that from counting. Measured against desktop Chrome: nothing differs by more than 2 levels, geometry an exact match.
